details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 2 steps 4,6 (scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:2753) | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `harness_family` is frozen into scope_inputs_frozen.json but the fixed jq projection at line 2753 feeding `heal-scope render` is never updated, so render never receives it.
  WHY: `data.get("harness_family")` is always empty, so G1/G2 never take effect while isolated unit tests still pass; severity disagreement: MAJOR vs BLOCKER, highest used.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 1 step 5 (scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:1122-1125) | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `validation-route-fix:v1` marker contains the substring `workflow-failure-heal:validation-route`, so the `grep -v` at line 1122 strips it before the route marker is appended.
  WHY: The tracking issue never carries the fix SHA and D6/G4 silently degrades to pin-ancestry behaviour; the line must be appended after the filter; severity disagreement MAJOR vs BLOCKER, highest used.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 1 step 3 (scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:179, 211, 984-988) | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The compare call uses undefined `${DEFAULT_BRANCH}`; the script only has `PROVENANCE_DEFAULT_BRANCH` and `TARGET_BRANCH_DEFAULT`.
  WHY: Under `set -u` the intake aborts, and an empty value makes the compare fail and disables suppression via `compare_failed`; severity disagreement MAJOR vs BLOCKER, highest used.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 1 step 4 (scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:2520-2543, 3006-3027, 3017, 3024) | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The plan sets `CLASSIFICATION=already-fixed` and skips diagnosis, but line 2520 recomputes it from `DIAG_FILE` and the already-fixed arm (3006-3027, not 2993-3000) runs `cat "${DIAG_FILE}"` on a missing file.
  WHY: Under `set -e` the intake aborts before the outcome comment is posted, or the classification is overwritten to inconclusive, so suppression does not work; severity disagreement MAJOR vs BLOCKER, highest used.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 3 "Closing"/D9 (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15854-15872) | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Closing a heal issue `not_planned` can park a hold, because the hold tick's `not_planned` branch calls `_validation_harness_hold_end_park` with a CRITICAL page; the hold waits on the pin, not source resolution.
  WHY: The auto-close creates the human-attention outcome the plan sets out to remove; severity disagreement MAJOR vs BLOCKER, highest used.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 3 step 2 (.github/workflow/validate.yml:1388-1396, 1803-1821) | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: A validate run concluding `success` is counted as a validation pass, but a Claude-capacity-wait run concludes `success` without a verdict.
  WHY: The hourly scan can close a heal issue `not_planned` while the harness defect is still live; positive pass evidence is required.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 3 step 3(b) (scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:5182) | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `repository.issue(number:N)` lookup, scoped to consumer repos, does not resolve PR-sourced or self-repo-sourced heals and has no per-alias NOT_FOUND handling.
  WHY: Those heals stay `unknown`/`keep` forever so G5 is unmet, and one NOT_FOUND alias may fail the whole repo batch.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 3 step 3 (scripts/workflow_failure_heal_recovery_scan.sh:33, 35-36, 117-135, 162, 184-192) | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The reused recovery scan exits unless `HEAL_SCOPE_RECOVERY_ENABLED` is on and the event is `schedule`, and its listing excludes issues with a scope marker; the plan bypasses none of this.
  WHY: The new mode never runs on dispatch or with the switch off, and never sees the scoped heal issues it targets; severity disagreement MAJOR vs BLOCKER (minimax task gap), highest used.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 2 steps 7,9 (scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:3340, 3112-3115) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_heal_scope_marker_shape_ok` and `_safe_heal_path` cannot distinguish a directory from a file, so the planned reject tests cannot pass without a new rule.
  WHY: An extension heuristic would reject legitimate extensionless markers like Makefile/Dockerfile; the restriction belongs in `render_heal_scope_marker`.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 3 steps 3-4 (.github/workflows/workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml:240-245, 371-381, 442-445, 508) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `source-resolved-scan` job closes heal issues without the heal-intake queue ticket, under a distinct concurrency group, and without re-reading comments before the PATCH.
  WHY: An intake occurrence can land on an issue that is then closed `not_planned`, triggering a CRITICAL hold park and losing the occurrence.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 3 step 3 close path | severity=nit | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: No dedup guard exists if the close comment posts but the PATCH fails.
  WHY: The next hourly scan re-posts the close comment, accumulating duplicates.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 4 step 3 and risk line 438 (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15660-15666, 16110-16111, 16128-16129, 16153-16163) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Integration-advance resumes are charged to the same `by_fp`/`total` counters that gate hold entry.
  WHY: Two consumer merges exhaust `by_fp`, so the next `harness_error` is `capped` and parks with a CRITICAL page and a later harness fix cannot auto-resume.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 4 step 3 placement (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:15731-15732, 15820-15825, 15717-15723) | severity=blocker | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The integration-advance resume is placed before pin resolution, so `_validation_harness_hold_resume` is called with an empty/`unknown` pin.
  WHY: The resume fails or posts a comment with pin=unknown; the block must move after pin resolution; severity disagreement MAJOR vs BLOCKER, highest used.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 4 steps 2-3 (G6) (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:16085-16123) | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The trigger only checks that the head differs from `integration_head` recorded at failure detection, with no ahead-of-baseline check.
  WHY: A reset or non-descendant rebuild consumes a resume and a merge landing before detection is baked into the baseline; severity disagreement NIT vs MAJOR, highest used.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 1 step 1 regex; D5 and risk line 431 | severity=nit | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The trailing `(?![0-9])` boundary lets `owner/repo#579abc` match, and any later commit citing the source (including docs-only) matches, so the "one promotion cycle" bound is overstated.
  WHY: Heals are suppressed repeatedly on unrelated references.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Constraints §15 line 79, Phase 4 steps 2-3 (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:5570-5581) | severity=major | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `_branch_head_sha` is an uncached REST GET and the hold tick resolves no head today, so "Phase 4 adds no API call" is wrong.
  WHY: One extra REST GET per held project per 5-minute tick; severity disagreement NIT vs MAJOR, highest used.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Phase 3 step 3 API budget; §15 line 85 | severity=nit | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The budget says one aliased GraphQL read per repo, but batching is 25 issues per call.
  WHY: Repos with more than 25 candidates need multiple calls, so the budget undercounts.
- docs/plans/heal-issues-self-resolve-plan.md:Goal G7, Phase 2 rollback (scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py:128-146, 458-467, 944-948) | severity=nit | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `.j2` admission in `allowed()` and the step-glob transfer fix have no off switch.
  WHY: G7's claim that switching off restores today's behaviour is false for these two changes; only a revert rolls them back.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:2520, 2324, 3017, 3024, 179 | severity=major | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The script references undefined `DEFAULT_BRANCH` and anchors the already-fixed check at 2993-3000 instead of 3006-3027.
  WHY: `set -u` aborts on the undefined variable and the wrong anchor misdirects the dedup logic.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: G1 — a `validation_failure` heal reporting `raw_status=harness_error family=<f>` gets this scope derived from run metadata
  expected_change_site: Phase 2 step 4 jq projection (scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:2309-2317) and `_open_issue` (scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:6501-6529)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: the projection has no `harness_family` field so `heal-scope render` always sees it empty and G1/G2 never take effect
- requirement: G6 — a consumer poller re-validates once per new integration-branch head that is past the failed run's head
  expected_change_site: Phase 4 steps 2-3, `mark_validation_failed` hold entry and `validation_harness_hold_tick`
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: `integration_head` is recorded at failure detection not dispatch, and the "differs" trigger has no ahead-of-baseline check so a reset or rebuild resumes
- requirement: G3/G4 — the new fix line must reach the tracking issue so the poller can read it
  expected_change_s
